correctness.rationale: Exact indicator orthogonality gives 81 times each count, Weil bounds each support-k character sum by (k-1)sqrt(p) for 2<=k<=4, yielding a uniform 136sqrt(p) error; four excluded zero shifts contribute at most 108. The lower bound p-136sqrt(p)-108 is positive for p>=19000. Below 19000, a full sieve of 1072 eligible primes and two independent labeling methods proves the 39-prime list. Verified p547 sole word (0,2,2,0), p571 complete. The finite checks do not assert an infinite result without Weil.

value.rationale: Four consecutive cubic-coset classes form a natural complete 81-word arithmetic invariant. The result settles its exact universal prime cutoff and complete 39-prime exceptional set. The final obstruction at p547 is mixed and persists after the last all-cubic obstruction p379, so old triplet results or a single-color test do not determine the classification.
